gen-zen-dots-gf-scope-one: Techy, friendly, and a little spacey: Zen Dots gives every letter its own breathing room. Scope One follows in a refined serif whose stubby ascenders sit under a big x-height, so paragraphs feel sturdy and traditional.
gen-zen-dots-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is a dignified text serif with large open counters, set under the roomy, techy letters of Zen Dots. It reads like an old bookish voice, steady and easy through many paragraphs.
gen-zen-dots-gf-suwannaphum: Zen Dots is all generous gaps and friendly tech attitude, with openings that stay wide at every weight. Suwannaphum answers in a dignified, editorial serif, its tall x-height giving paragraphs a solid woodblock feel.
gen-almendra-display-fs-amulya: Amulya reads modern and open, with curves that never close up. Under the ornate, literary Almendra Display, paragraphs feel contemporary and unhurried, giving the page a quiet counterweight to the heading's flourish.
gen-almendra-display-fs-chillax: Chillax brings a casual, relaxed line, like spaghetti laid out in letters, with curves that lift off before the loop closes. And Almendra Display, ornate and literary with its tall x-height, gives that looseness a more storybook footing over a full page.
gen-almendra-display-fs-plein: Almendra Display has letters that never pinch shut, ornate and literary with a pronounced x-height. Plein is the reliable counterpart, its clear channel into every round letter making the pair feel dependable and clean.
gen-almendra-display-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans brings wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with strokes of identical weight, so it feels approachable and contemporary. Almendra Display adds the calligraphic shading it lacks.
gen-almendra-display-fs-synonym: Ornate yet open: Almendra Display hands the page a literary flourish up top. Synonym follows as a plain sans, a dependable stripe of constant ink with generous curves, so long paragraphs move along without friction.
gen-almendra-display-gf-aclonica: Professional in manner, Aclonica stretches out a long, widely spaced line with a deep midsection, set beneath the ornate, literary Almendra Display. Their strongest quality is how differently each one handles stroke contrast.
gen-almendra-display-gf-allerta: Allerta is neutral, with wide, loose tracking and a prominent x-height. Make Almendra Display small and its ornate, literary detail would get lost, so let it lead big while the plain sans stays on the body.
